correctness.rationale: For the explicitly defined 24-vertex LCF([-12,7,-7]^8) graph, forming the integral 23x23 reduced Laplacian and computing its Smith invariants gives exactly nineteen unit factors followed by 11,44,132,2640; these divide successively and multiply to 168,664,320. The package supplies 471 individual unimodular row/column operations in certificate.json, with complete diagonal [1]*19+[11,44,132,2640], and separately a prime-power valuation check. I reconstructed its LCF adjacency/Laplacian independently and computed the exact Smith normal form directly with SymPy, obtaining the same four nonunit factors and determinant; this is a complete finite calculation for the specified graph, not an inference from its eigenvalues or spanning-tree count. The 2,3,5,11 primary exponents recombine to that invariant-factor chain.
residual_risks: Direct finite computations independently checked specific cases only; infinite assertions are supported by the reconstructed analytic proof, not computer output.

value.rationale: The McGee graph is the canonical unique (3,7) cubic cage. Its integral graph Jacobian (sandpile group), minimal number of generators, exponent, and 11-primary structure are natural exact invariants of the graph, sharper than the known spanning-tree count; exact values are relevant for chip-firing and integral lattice comparisons. This is a motivated, reproducible single-graph classification, not an inflated claim about all cages or a mere known-table recomputation.
